name: Sea Of Galilee
overview: The Sea of Galilee, also known as the sea of Chinnereth, holds significant biblical importance as the setting for key moments in Jesus' earthly ministry. It is where Jesus called His first disciples, Simon Peter and Andrew, who were fishermen casting their nets (Matthew 4:18; Mark 1:16). This body of water also witnessed Jesus' miraculous walk upon its surface during the night (Matthew 14:25), and it served as a place where He taught and revealed Himself to His followers (Matthew 15:29; Matthew 28:10). Scripture highlights the Sea of Galilee not only as a geographical location but as a backdrop for divine encounters and the unfolding of Christ’s redemptive work.
